context:
Goal: MANIFEST works well on the open iPhone Duo, in the Card in Hand design you picked on 2026-10-27 12:25 CDT.
Problem (rule): degen puts the left page on top when the pages stack. MANIFEST's pick departs from that ruling, so it needs your word.
Based on (read): README, choice 8: the keys need the bottom page.
Departs from: degen's stack order, left page on top — MANIFEST puts the answer on top and the keys below.

options.gain: The envelope stays in view while you type.
options.how: The answer page goes on top and the keys on the bottom page.
options.label: Answer on top, keys below

options.how: The left page goes on top, as in degen.
options.label: Degen's order
options.lose: The keys cover all but one line of the envelope.

ref: mailaudit #144 (Duo round 2, Card in Hand; branch design/duo-round2, head 441b4e46d); its README, section Choices
title: Duo held tall: answer on top, or degen's order?
why: The design lane picks a: degen's order hides the envelope behind the keys.
